# Fixture snapshots

`search_de.json`, `search_ch_fr.json`, `redirect_saturn.json`, `product_de_offers.json`, and `missing_product.json` are reduced snapshots of public storefront responses captured on 11 November 2026. Only fields required by the parser are retained; cookies, identifiers from request tracking, account data, and unrelated page content are excluded. Prices, status, and availability are historical test data, not live values.

`product_relationships.json` is synthetic and checks edge cases that may not appear in a current response.
